phases: all
condition: Wake category from the type: J if the type is A388 (A380-800); H if MTOW >= 136000 kg; M if 7000 kg < MTOW < 136000 kg; L if MTOW <= 7000 kg
exceptions: none
source_paragraph: MATS Pt1 5.9.1 Table 5-6, Notes 1-2; 7.3.1 ii (call sign suffix Super for A380); Fiji AIC 11/22 2.1.1 (Doc 4444 4.9.1 wording, four categories)
india_difference: MATS uses three categories and names the A380-800 in every table instead of a J category. The numbers are the same as ICAO's J rows, so a J enum holding only A388 reproduces MATS exactly
game_note: Sim enum Wake{L M H J} fits. J must hold only A388

phases: lead: TakeoffRoll->Airborne(d); follow: TakeoffRoll->Airborne(d)
condition: Follower lifts off from the same runway, same direction, after the leader
minimum: J->H 120; J->M 180; J->L 180; H->M 120; H->L 120; M->L 120; every other pair 0
exceptions: none for departures; MATS 5.9.2 exempts only arrivals (VFR, or visual approach with own separation)
india_difference: None in the values. MATS names no reference event. Its note on p.5-37 says vortex generation begins at nose-wheel lift-off, which fixes the leader's event only
game_note: Matches wake_min_s in conflict.rs exactly. Every sim roll is ROLL_TICKS = 750, so lift-off to lift-off equals roll start to roll start

phases: as W1, leader and follower on two runways of one pair
condition: As W1 when the runways are parallel and their centrelines are less than 760 m apart
exceptions: none
source_paragraph: MATS Pt1 5.9.5.1 b); VIDP AD 2.22 IX 2 d, f, g (pairs dependent; no simultaneous departures 27/28, 09/10, 29R/29L, 11L/11R)
india_difference: VIDP adds its own pairing: the two runways of each system are dependent
game_note: IGI 11L/29R to 11R/29L: 381 m (computed from AD 2.12 coordinates). 09 and 10: 438 m at the west thresholds, widening to 760 m at 1408 m along 09, the sim's lift-off point. Link 09<->10 as Parallel: the AIP calls them dependent and forbids simultaneous departures

phases: as W1
condition: As W1 when the follower's projected flight path crosses the leader's at the same altitude or less than 1000 ft (300 m) below; applies to crossing runways and to parallels 760 m or more apart
exceptions: none
india_difference: MATS states 1000 ft with no metric value
game_note: Sim projects paths straight for PROJECT_M = 10 km (authored, no SIDs) and always assumes the altitude test holds. IGI: 27<->28

phases: as W1; follower starts from an intermediate part of the same runway or of a parallel under 760 m
condition: Follower's start of roll is on an intermediate part of the runway
minimum: J->M 240; J->L 240; H->M 180; H->L 180; M->L 180; J->H no row: apply W1 (120); every other pair 0
exceptions: none
source_paragraph: MATS Pt1 5.9.5.2 Table 5-9; intermediate threshold 150 m: Doc 4444 5.8.3.4 via Airservices AIP (snippet, from PLAN-twr.md B4)
india_difference: MATS Table 5-9 has no A380->HEAVY row, and MATS gives no distance for what counts as intermediate
game_note: Sim adds 60 s to every nonzero W1 pair, so J->H intermediate needs 180 s in the sim against MATS's 120 s. That is a false-alarm window of 120-180 s. Keep INTERMEDIATE_M = 150 labelled secondary

applies_between: ARR->DEP displaced threshold or paired runway
phases: lead: Final->Landing(d1); follow: TakeoffRoll->Airborne(d2), d2 = d1 or its pair (29L->29R, 11R->11L)
condition: Leader is a heavier arrival (J, or H, or M with an L follower). Follower departs the same runway or its pair, and its lift-off point lies upstream of the point abeam the arrival's touchdown (TDZ = landing threshold + 400 m), so the projected paths cross
minimum: J arr->M dep 180; J arr->L dep 180; H arr->M dep 120; H arr->L dep 120; M arr->L dep 120; every other pair 0
measured_from: leader crosses its landing threshold (sim: Final->Landing tick)
exceptions: Does not apply when the follower lifts off at or beyond the touchdown abeam point
source_paragraph: MATS Pt1 5.9.6.1 Table 5-10 rows 1, 3, 4; VIDP AD 2.20 1.10, 1.11 b)
grade: primary (values; VIDP applies it); authored (TDZ offset 400 m; time reference)
india_difference: VIDP-specific: AD 2.20 names the entries and take-off runs that trigger it. 29R: P2 under 600 m, P4/P5 under 1400 m, P6/P7/P8 under 2000 m. 11L: R5 under 600 m, R6/R7 under 900 m
game_note: Not modelled today (PLAN B5 lists it out of scope). Westerly: a 29R full-length lift-off (1406 m from the start) is 599 m short of the abeam point (2005 m from the 29R start), so every full-length 29R departure behind a heavier 29L arrival needs this. Easterly: an 11L full-length lift-off is 537 m past the abeam point (869 m from the 11L start), so it never applies

applies_between: DEP->ARR displaced threshold or paired runway
phases: lead: TakeoffRoll->Airborne(d1); follow: Final->Landing(d2), d2 = d1 or its pair
condition: Leader is a heavier departure, follower an arrival, and the departure's lift-off point lies upstream of the arrival's touchdown abeam point, so the arrival descends through the departure's climb
minimum: J dep->M arr 180; J dep->L arr 180; H dep->M arr 120; H dep->L arr 120; M dep->L arr 120; every other pair 0
exceptions: Does not apply when the departure lifts off at or beyond the arrival's touchdown abeam point
grade: primary (values); authored (applicability test, which is the same geometry as W4)
india_difference: AD 2.20 states only the arrival->departure case for VIDP. AD 2.22 IX 2 d) makes the pair in-trail for all relevant separation
game_note: Westerly 29R full length -> 29L applies (lift-off 599 m upstream of the abeam point). Easterly 11L -> 11R does not

phases: lead: GoAround(d1); follow: TakeoffRoll(reciprocal of d1) or Final(reciprocal of d1, or of its pair under 760 m)
condition: Heavier aircraft makes a low or missed approach; lighter aircraft takes off from the opposite-direction runway, or lands on it or on an opposite-direction parallel under 760 m
exceptions: none
india_difference: none found
game_note: Unreachable while the sim runs one flow at a time (B4, B9). Implement with B9's runway changes

phases: lead: Final, Landing or GoAround(d); follow: Final(d)
condition: Follower directly behind the leader at the same altitude or less than 1000 ft below, on the same runway or a parallel under 760 m, or crossing behind it
minimum: J->H 6; J->M 7; J->L 8; H->H 4; H->M 5; H->L 6; M->L 5; J->J, M->H, M->M, L->any: not required (W8 applies)
exceptions: Not required for VFR arrivals behind H/M, or visual approaches with own separation (MATS 5.9.2)
india_difference: Same distances as ICAO's four-category scheme. No RECAT use found for India
game_note: traffic.rs final_wake_nm has no (M, L) => 5 row. Latent: B6 flies no L type at IGI. Spacing on final is set by the spawner (approach's job), so a breach here is a spawner bug, not a player incident

phases: Final(d) pairs, and arrivals to two runways in one stream
condition: Least spacing between successive arrivals
minimum: 3 NM at or below FL140 within 60 NM of DPN with ASR available; 5 NM otherwise
exceptions: Larger of W7 and W8 applies (MATS Table 8-2 note *)
source_paragraph: VIDP AD 2.22 IX 4 a); MATS Pt1 8.16.1 a), e); AD 2.22 IX 2 c) (arrivals to two runways are one stream)
india_difference: India permits 3 NM where authorised; VIDP is authorised
game_note: FINAL_MIN_NM = 3 is correct; regrade from memory to primary. The spawner spaces each runway alone, while AD 2.22 IX 2 c) treats arrivals to two runways (28 and 29L) as one sequence. That belongs to B6, not B4

phases: follow: LinedUp->TakeoffRoll(d); others on runway d or its reciprocal: Landing, LinedUp or LineUp ahead, crossing ahead, TakeoffRoll or Airborne not yet Departed
condition: Take-off may not start until every preceding departure has crossed the runway end (or started a turn) and every preceding landing aircraft is clear of the runway
exceptions: Clear means the entire aircraft is beyond the runway-holding position. A crosser or lined-up aircraft behind the departure's start does not count
india_difference: None. Same as Doc 4444 7.9.2 (snippet, PLAN B4)
game_note: Matches the sim's R1 and R2. The started-a-turn escape is not modelled; sim departures fly straight out

phases: intruder: any phase entering the runway span; victim: TakeoffRoll, Landing, or Final(d) inside DECISION_M
condition: Incorrect presence of an aircraft on the protected area of a runway: entering the runway span ahead of an aircraft rolling or about to land on it
measured_from: intruder's first tick inside the runway span
exceptions: Not an incursion when the intruder is behind the roller
india_difference: none
game_note: Span = R4. Adding Final inside DECISION_M (1160 m) catches an incursion before the threshold. Today it is caught only at the threshold, as R5

phases: any aircraft on a runway or its holding area
condition: On the runway means between the runway-holding positions: on a runway edge, or within HOLD_SHORT_M of a runway node along the aircraft's own route
exceptions: Vacated = entire aircraft beyond the runway-holding position
source_paragraph: MATS Pt1 7.6.3.1.2 b), 7.10.3.4 (vacate definition); 90 m: Annex 14 Table 3-2, recalled, not read
india_difference: none found
game_note: OSM holding points are used where present. VIDP's own holding-position distances not found

phases: follow: Final->Landing(d) at the landing threshold; others: as R1
condition: A landing aircraft may not cross the runway threshold until every preceding departure has crossed the runway end (or started a turn) and every preceding landing aircraft is clear of the runway
measured_from: arrival crossing the AIP landing threshold
exceptions: Clear as in R1
india_difference: none
game_note: The sim checks at the physical runway end. AIP thresholds are displaced 1460 m (29L), 730 m (29R), 670 m (11L), 645 m (11R) and 151 m (27), and none on 09, 10, 28. On 29L the check fires about 21 s (417 ticks at 70 m/s) before the real threshold, a false-alarm window

phases: arrival Final->Landing(d1) vs departure TakeoffRoll or Airborne(d2), and departure TakeoffRoll(d2) vs GoAround(d1), with d1/d2 a pair in one flow: 29L/29R, 11R/11L, 27/28, 09/10
condition: Permissive reading: an arrival may not cross its threshold while a departure on the paired runway is rolling or airborne before its runway end; a departure may not start its roll while a go-around on the paired runway is still over that runway
measured_from: arrival threshold-crossing tick; departure first TakeoffRoll tick
exceptions: Northern vs Southern system: independent (R7)
source_paragraph: VIDP AD 2.22 IX 1, 2 d), f), g)
india_difference: VIDP-specific: a movement on the arrival runway counts as a movement on the departure runway for applying separation
game_note: Strict reading (R1 and R5 in full across the pair) is an open question. Permissive is what any reading of the text requires, so it cannot raise a false alarm

phases: any phases on a Northern runway (09/27, 10/28) vs any on a Southern runway (11L/29R, 11R/29L)
condition: Departures are independent across systems when they follow the published SID or non-RNAV instructions. Arrivals are never independent (one stream, W8)
exceptions: none
source_paragraph: VIDP AD 2.22 IX 2 c), e); Doc 4444 6.7.2.2 a) 760 m and 15 deg divergence (via CASA CD 1903AS Annex B)
india_difference: VIDP sets the pairing
game_note: Centreline spacing 10/28 to 11L/29R: 2169-2235 m. No runway check between systems; the sim already has none

phases: C pressed on Final(d) while another aircraft is Final(d) ahead
condition: A landing clearance may not be issued until a preceding landing aircraft has crossed the threshold; it needs reasonable assurance that R5 will hold
exceptions: none
india_difference: none
game_note: Procedural error, not a conflict. Log it as a plain-ink note. No verb refuses (PLAN B4)

phases: Final(d), cleared, with runway d obstructed
condition: When the runway is obstructed after a landing clearance, the controller instructs a go-around
exceptions: none
india_difference: none
game_note: No new check: a missed G shows up as R5 at the threshold. A1 gives the warning

phases: Final(d) or TakeoffRoll(d) vs any aircraft predicted to be in the span of d
condition: Live conflict (not counted) when R5 or R3 is predicted to break: flight time to threshold <= T2 and the obstruction is predicted to be still in the span at the threshold time. Neutral info at T1
measured_to: predicted threshold-crossing time at current speed
exceptions: No alert when the obstruction's predicted exit time is before the arrival's threshold time
india_difference: none found
game_note: Game time. 15 s game is 5 s real at 3x (PLAN A2). The prediction clause keeps a crossing that finishes in time from ever turning red

applies_between: runway crossing vs arrival or departure
phases: crosser: HoldShort->Taxi across d; others: Final(d), TakeoffRoll(d), LinedUp(d)
condition: Crossing needs a specific clearance. No numeric minimum exists against an aircraft on final. Incident only through R3 (ahead of a roll) or R5 (still in span when an arrival crosses the threshold)
exceptions: Crossing ahead of a LinedUp aircraft is not a conflict until K (then R1)
india_difference: None. MATS has no time or distance figure
game_note: Live warning through A1

phases: LineUp(d) at entry E vs Final(d) inside DECISION_M, or Landing(d) not yet past E
condition: An aircraft may not line up on the approach end of a runway while another aircraft is landing, until the landing aircraft has passed the point of intended holding
measured_from: lining-up aircraft enters the span at E
exceptions: Line-up after the landing aircraft has passed E is allowed (conditional line-up behind)
grade: primary (rule); authored (effecting a landing = inside DECISION_M 1160 m, or Landing)
india_difference: none
game_note: Incident class: Incursion. Without this rule, a line-up ahead of a cleared arrival is caught only at the threshold (R5) and only if still there

phases: LineUp(d) issued with condition behind X
condition: Conditional line-up is allowed only when the aircraft causing the condition is the first to pass in front and both are seen. It is given as identification, condition, clearance, reiteration
exceptions: Not for movements affecting an active runway unless both aircraft are seen
india_difference: none
game_note: Not a verb yet. When built, the sim holds execution until X has passed E. Execution before that is an R3 incursion

phases: LinedUp(d)
condition: No maximum time on the runway found. Once cleared for take-off after lining up, the aircraft must start its roll immediately
exceptions: n/a
india_difference: No figure in MATS or the VIDP AIP
game_note: Waiting lined up is never an incident by itself. R5 covers a lined-up aircraft during a landing

phases: TakeoffRoll or Final vs preceding aircraft on the same runway
condition: Not available: MATS Pt1 2018 has no RRSM procedure, only phraseology headings (12.16.4.11, 12.16.4.16). EU AMC9 ATS.TR.210 lists the ICAO-style conditions and minima: 2400 m for Category 3, daylight, visibility 5 km, tailwind 5 kt, wake still applies
exceptions: Never between a departure and a preceding landing aircraft
source_paragraph: MATS Pt1 ch 7 (absent); CAA CZ AltMoC 01/22 (EU AMC9 ATS.TR.210(c)(2)(i)) (f)
india_difference: No RRSM in India's MATS 2018. Whether a later edition or VIDP's MATS Part 2 permits it: not found
game_note: Do not implement. Every IGI movement is Category 3, and R1/R5 stay the rule

phases: Final(d) under LVP
condition: Landing clearance not later than 2 NM from touchdown, otherwise a missed approach
exceptions: none
india_difference: VIDP-specific
game_note: The sim's DECISION_M of 1160 m becomes 3704 m under LVP (B9)

phases: C on Final(d) under LVP
condition: Landing clearance not issued until the preceding arrival has vacated the localizer sensitive area (LSA) and the preceding departure is airborne and has passed over the localizer antenna
exceptions: none
india_difference: VIDP-specific
game_note: Needs LSA geometry from AD 2.24 charts (not extracted). B9

phases: any aircraft in the LSA of d vs Final(d) inside 2 NM to Landing(d) end
condition: The LSA in front of an arriving aircraft may not be infringed from 2 NM until it has completed its landing roll
exceptions: none
india_difference: VIDP-specific
game_note: Needs LSA geometry. B9

phases: Taxi under LVP
condition: Taxi on the prescribed low-visibility routes, one-way flow. At taxiway intersections hold no closer than the clearance bar or stop bar
exceptions: Alternative routes for operational reasons
source_paragraph: VIDP AD 2.22 VIII 4.3.2, 4.4.4 Table 2; MATS Pt1 7.11.1.2.1
india_difference: VIDP-specific
game_note: No new minimum. G1 unchanged under LVP

phases: Taxi, Pushback, HoldPosition, HoldShort, Holding, LineUp (on the ground net) vs same
condition: No ICAO or MATS minimum exists. Pilots keep their own spacing. Game: centre-to-centre distance along the network on the mover's cleared route; live conflict when under 300 m and closing; incident when under 45 m
measured_to: other aircraft position along the route network
exceptions: Two stopped aircraft; aircraft on stand; aircraft on runway phases (G2 in PLAN B4)
source_paragraph: MATS Pt1 8.21.2.3.2 (pilots keep collision avoidance on the ground); 7.1.1.3; EUROCONTROL-SPEC-171 3.3.5 (RMCA is runway-only), App. B Taxi vs Taxi (route-based); App. C route deviation about 25 m
india_difference: No Indian figure. VIDP AD 2.20 1.13 asks for adequate clearance at intersections, with no number
game_note: Keep along-route measurement: A-SMGCS also predicts taxi conflicts on routes (converging, deadlock), not by straight-line distance

applies_between: PUSHBACK vs PUSHBACK on an apron
phases: Pushback vs Pushback, by stand
condition: Pushbacks separated by one stand on every apron except 32 and 34. On Aprons 32, 34, II (bays 201-215, 220-231) and Cargo: one pushback per block at a time. Wide-body pushback on 32 and 34: two Code E/F stands from another pushback
exceptions: Listed simultaneous-pushback exceptions (e.g. Apron I F3/F5 Code C, visibility 100 m or more)
source_paragraph: VIDP AD 2.20 1.4, 2.2 notes i-iv, 2.5.2 note ii, 2.5.4 note ii, 2.5.6.2
india_difference: VIDP-specific
game_note: Sim stands carry no order or block data (PLAN A14). Not codeable until the stand table has neighbours and blocks
